name: @flatrimony/db-types
description: Kysely table types generated from supabase/migrations (run `pnpm --filter @flatrimony/db-types generate` with the local DB running)

scripts.generate: kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --url "${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres}" --include-pattern "(ref|private|public|supabase_migrations).*" --out-file src/db.ts && prettier --write src/db.ts
